Tonic.Message: A toxic chill spreads through the body.
Heat blooms outward in a violent flash.

Reagent.FlavorText: Warm to the touch; crumbles with a spark. (heat, volatile)
Slow, greasy, eager to burn. (combustible, viscous)
A slow warmth lingers on the tongue. (heat, sweet)
Rimed fronds that ache the fingertips. (cold)
Cracks with a deep, patient chill; sets like mortar. (cold, binding)
Stings the nose; hums faintly against the jar. (corrosive, conductive)
Hairs rise near its severed end. (conductive)
Harvested from something that bit first. (toxic)
Clinging tar with a sour reek. (toxic, viscous)
Beats faintly. Tastes of nothing much. (vital, sweet)
Hard as a knuckle; sets like mortar. (binding)
Do not shake. Do not warm. (volatile, combustible)

Tonic.Message: Caustic green liquid hisses against your skin.
Static crackles across your skin and hair stands on end.
An ice-cold draught freezes you from the inside.
Cool water, all the way down.
Sharp pain blooms — your wounds reopen.
Bitter ash coats your tongue — your skin hardens against future fire.
The bitter tonic neutralizes the poison.
A warm light floods through you, purging all afflictions.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: You study the faded ink carefully. The rite of water purification takes shape in your mind.
You study the diagrams of force and fracture. The mending rite settles into your hands.
You trace the warding sigils with your eyes. The kindle rite sparks to life in your memory.
Flame-script blazes across the page. The kindle rite burns itself into your mind.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the kindle rite.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: Water-words ripple across the vellum. The quench rite flows into your memory.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the quench rite.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: The pages ignite as you read, yet do not burn. The conflagration rite sears itself into your will.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the conflagration rite.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: Crystalline glyphs bite your fingertips. The ice lance rite chills into your mind.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the ice lance rite.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: Corrosive ink hisses as you read. The acid spray rite eats its way into your mind.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the acid spray rite.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: Static crackles across the vellum. The arc bolt rite sparks into your memory.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the arc bolt rite.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: Frost lances spiral from the margins. The rime nova rite buries itself in your will.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the rime nova rite.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: Thunder rolls from the open pages. The thunderclap rite booms itself into your will.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the thunderclap rite.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: A vein of embers traces the page. The ember vein rite burns itself into your will.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the ember vein rite.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: Warm script flickers in the margins. You learn kindle flame.
The page exhales a dry wind. You learn drying breeze.
Steady embers glow between the lines. You learn hearthwarm.
Condensation beads across the page. You learn conjure water.
A biting draft slips from the pages. You learn chill draft.
The ink brightens to a cleansing sheen. You learn ward gleam.

Schematic.LearnMessage: The whetstone angles, the draw-stroke counts -- the honing pattern settles into your hands.
Overlap the plates like river-scale, the notes say. You see how it carries the blow.
The tailoring lines are drawn for someone who plans to be missed. You take the pattern.

blueprints.description: A seam of light-hoarding quartz. It hums faintly when you stand close.

Examinable.Description: A seam of light-hoarding quartz. It hums faintly when you stand close.

blueprints.description: Crystallized white salt threaded through the limestone. The dead are said to hate it.

Examinable.Description: Crystallized white salt threaded through the limestone. The dead are said to hate it.

blueprints.description: Dark ore that rings like a struck bell when chipped. The Rot Choir prizes it.

Examinable.Description: Dark ore that rings like a struck bell when chipped. The Rot Choir prizes it.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: Thunder pools in the gutter of the page. The storm anvil is yours to bring down.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the storm anvil.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: The bolt hangs in the margin, refusing to fall. You learn to hold it there.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the hanging bolt.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: The page fogs and clears. Water and fire, held together just long enough.
Condensation beads, then hisses away. What soaks you can also shield you.
Grimoire.AlreadyKnownMessage: You already know the scalding veil.

Grimoire.LearnMessage: The page holds a single instruction: put the charge down, and let it find its own way.
Frost creeps from the spine as you read. What is frozen is not armoured — it is brittle.
The page is cold and very quiet. You learn how to make a heart forget to hurry.
Green rot flowers across the margin and eats the gilding. The bloom takes root in your hands.
A coin is pressed into the page, worn smooth on both faces. Whatever is owed, it pays.
One word, written far too many times. Reading it once is enough to leave things smaller.
Two columns, in two different inks. You learn which side of the ledger to stand on.

blueprints.description: Not hard to move because it is heavy. Hard to move because there is nowhere to hold it.

blueprints.description: A lidded box cut from one block. Whoever put it here did not expect it to leave.

blueprints.description: A roof timber, down and lying where it landed. One end is charred.

blueprints.description: Kept, and heavy with it. The salt has taken up residence in every part that used to be soft.

Examinable.Description: Kept, and heavy with it. The salt has taken up residence in every part that used to be soft.

blueprints.description: A wall of hawthorn and bramble, laid and woven by somebody's grandparents. It marks a boundary that no longer has a court to argue it.

Examinable.Description: A wall of hawthorn and bramble, laid and woven by somebody's grandparents. It marks a boundary that no longer has a court to argue it.

blueprints.description: Barley, planted in the old strips. Someone is coming back for this.

Examinable.Description: Barley, planted in the old strips. Someone is coming back for this.

blueprints.description: Packed earth over old stone, rutted by cartwheels. It goes somewhere, which is more than most things here do.

Examinable.Description: Packed earth over old stone, rutted by cartwheels. It goes somewhere, which is more than most things here do.

blueprints.description: Pale bells on thin stems, growing where nobody sowed them. They are said to keep. Nobody in the Spread can tell you what they keep away.

Examinable.Description: Pale bells on thin stems, growing where nobody sowed them. They are said to keep. Nobody in the Spread can tell you what they keep away.

blueprints.description: Petals someone hummed up for the season, a carved token half-buried underneath for whichever river-god still gets the offerings here. It won't last.

Examinable.Description: Petals someone hummed up for the season, a carved token half-buried underneath for whichever river-god still gets the offerings here. It won't last.

blueprints.description: A worn stone by the water, carved tokens left in its lap for whichever river-god still gets the offerings here. The Tree is a children's story in a place like this.

Examinable.Description: A worn stone by the water, carved tokens left in its lap for whichever river-god still gets the offerings here. The Tree is a children's story in a place like this.

blueprints.description: The pan cracked into plates as it dried. The ridges are sharp enough to read by.

Examinable.Description: The pan cracked into plates as it dried. The ridges are sharp enough to read by.

blueprints.description: Soft sand stacked steeper than it looks. Easier to go around than over.

Examinable.Description: Soft sand stacked steeper than it looks. Easier to go around than over.

blueprints.description: Picked clean and dried white. Whatever it was, it was walking the road.

Examinable.Description: Picked clean and dried white. Whatever it was, it was walking the road.

blueprints.description: A big banded lizard basking flat on the crust, all display and speed. It holds its ground like it owns the noon.

Examinable.Description: A big banded lizard basking flat on the crust, all display and speed. It holds its ground like it owns the noon.

blueprints.description: A grey briar that grows where nothing should, its leaves rimed with the pan's own salt. Caravans strip it as they pass.

Examinable.Description: A grey briar that grows where nothing should, its leaves rimed with the pan's own salt. Caravans strip it as they pass.

blueprints.description: Woven goat-hair, dense enough to keep the noon out. The wall of a house that moves.

Examinable.Description: Woven goat-hair, dense enough to keep the noon out. The wall of a house that moves.

blueprints.description: A dark cloth on a straight pole, hung where it can be seen from a long way off. What it offers holds for three days. Anyone following you knows what it means.

Examinable.Description: A dark cloth on a straight pole, hung where it can be seen from a long way off. What it offers holds for three days. Anyone following you knows what it means.

blueprints.description: Weathered, unhurried, watching the road the way a well-keeper watches the water level.

Examinable.Description: Weathered, unhurried, watching the road the way a well-keeper watches the water level.

blueprints.description: A planed board in the Concord's neat hand: WE CANNOT GUARANTEE DELIVERY BEYOND THIS POINT. Underneath, older and fainter, the same words twice more.

Examinable.Description: A planed board in the Concord's neat hand: WE CANNOT GUARANTEE DELIVERY BEYOND THIS POINT. Underneath, older and fainter, the same words twice more.

blueprints.description: A planed board in the Concord's neat hand: SURVEYED LINE AS POSTED. PRUNING BY THE DATE BELOW. The date has been scraped off and rewritten in a fresher ink, and the line beneath it is drawn straighter than the ground it describes.

Examinable.Description: A planed board in the Concord's neat hand: SURVEYED LINE AS POSTED. PRUNING BY THE DATE BELOW. The date has been scraped off and rewritten in a fresher ink, and the line beneath it is drawn straighter than the ground it describes.

blueprints.description: White to the elbows. The scales beside the ledger are cleaner than anything else in the camp.

Examinable.Description: White to the elbows. The scales beside the ledger are cleaner than anything else in the camp.

blueprints.description: Tea-dark and still. It holds what it takes; the bog country is patient that way.

Examinable.Description: Tea-dark and still. It holds what it takes; the bog country is patient that way.

blueprints.description: Planks laid on posts over the soft ground, worn smooth down the middle. Some of them answer your weight.

Examinable.Description: Planks laid on posts over the soft ground, worn smooth down the middle. Some of them answer your weight.

blueprints.description: Grey wood standing in the water it drowned in. It kept its shape better than its neighbors.

Examinable.Description: Grey wood standing in the water it drowned in. It kept its shape better than its neighbors.

blueprints.description: Cut peat, the tool marks still clean. The bank face is layered like a book nobody meant to write.

Examinable.Description: Cut peat, the tool marks still clean. The bank face is layered like a book nobody meant to write.

blueprints.description: A body the peat kept. Tanned dark as the water that took it; the knot in its cloak-cord is still a knot. It was not buried. It fell, and the bog wrote it down.

Examinable.Description: A body the peat kept. Tanned dark as the water that took it; the knot in its cloak-cord is still a knot. It was not buried. It fell, and the bog wrote it down.

blueprints.description: Older than the peat that holds it, and whole to the fingernails. A tin tag on waxed cord, Palimpsest work: 'Recension XI. Body-reading yields: leaf-light through high rooms; a name spoken to a tree, and answered. Reading incomplete.' The attribution is the expedition's. The body says nothing.

Examinable.Description: Older than the peat that holds it, and whole to the fingernails. A tin tag on waxed cord, Palimpsest work: 'Recension XI. Body-reading yields: leaf-light through high rooms; a name spoken to a tree, and answered. Reading incomplete.' The attribution is the expedition's. The body says nothing.

blueprints.description: Fat, green, and unbothered until you are close enough to matter. The peat-cutters render them for lamp oil and know which pools they breed in, and guard that knowing like money.

Examinable.Description: Fat, green, and unbothered until you are close enough to matter. The peat-cutters render them for lamp oil and know which pools they breed in, and guard that knowing like money.

blueprints.description: Banded scarlet over black, and the bands are not decoration. Everything in the bog knows not to touch it; the lesson is the skin.

Examinable.Description: Banded scarlet over black, and the bands are not decoration. Everything in the bog knows not to touch it; the lesson is the skin.

blueprints.description: Mostly mouth. It sits where the dead trees stand in the water and it does not chase, because it has never needed to.

Examinable.Description: Mostly mouth. It sits where the dead trees stand in the water and it does not chase, because it has never needed to.

blueprints.description: A bent stem strung with beads of something clearer than water. The beads do not fall. What it holds, it holds gently, and for exactly as long as it pleases; what it lets go walks away thinner.

Examinable.Description: A bent stem strung with beads of something clearer than water. The beads do not fall. What it holds, it holds gently, and for exactly as long as it pleases; what it lets go walks away thinner.

blueprints.description: Rendered fat in a stoppered gourd. Burns slow, smells like the bog it came from. Sumphold lamps run on it.

blueprints.description: A hull upside-down on trestles, ribs bare, seams waiting for pitch. Sumphold builds shallow and wide, for water that is mostly patience.

Examinable.Description: A hull upside-down on trestles, ribs bare, seams waiting for pitch. Sumphold builds shallow and wide, for water that is mostly patience.

blueprints.description: Bound crossing-counts under a rain-hood, a century deep and mould-spotted: carts, heads, coin, initials. One entry is pressed harder than the rest of its year: short count -- forgiven -- my error. The rolls do not record a face.

Examinable.Description: Bound crossing-counts under a rain-hood, a century deep and mould-spotted: carts, heads, coin, initials. One entry is pressed harder than the rest of its year: short count -- forgiven -- my error. The rolls do not record a face.

blueprints.description: A numbered stake, paint gone grey. The numbering starts somewhere out of sight and does not appear to be close to done.

Examinable.Description: A numbered stake, paint gone grey. The numbering starts somewhere out of sight and does not appear to be close to done.

blueprints.description: A long table under canvas, scrubbed pale. Straps, padded blocks, a folio stand: everything arranged so a body may be read without being moved more than it must be. The attending junior's stool sits where the light is worst.

Examinable.Description: A long table under canvas, scrubbed pale. Straps, padded blocks, a folio stand: everything arranged so a body may be read without being moved more than it must be. The attending junior's stool sits where the light is worst.

blueprints.description: Ink to the second knuckle, and a table of attributions never out of reach. Reads everything twice; asserts almost nothing.

Examinable.Description: Ink to the second knuckle, and a table of attributions never out of reach. Reads everything twice; asserts almost nothing.

blueprints.description: Gloves, always. A ledger of numbered things, each entry ending in the same word. Handles everything as if it were on loan, which, per the files, it is.

Examinable.Description: Gloves, always. A ledger of numbered things, each entry ending in the same word. Handles everything as if it were on loan, which, per the files, it is.

blueprints.description: Boots to the thigh and a blade like a long spade worn to a shine. Smells of smoke that never quite goes out.

Examinable.Description: Boots to the thigh and a blade like a long spade worn to a shine. Smells of smoke that never quite goes out.

blueprints.description: Wrapped, waxed, and corded to Curation intake standard; the sorter's stamp is in the seal. The label, in a careful hand: one entry. Status: continuing. It is heavier than it looks, and it looks heavy.

Examinable.Description: Wrapped, waxed, and corded to Curation intake standard; the sorter's stamp is in the seal. The label, in a careful hand: one entry. Status: continuing. It is heavier than it looks, and it looks heavy.

blueprints.description: The intake window of Marrowstye is a person at a table, and the person is this one. Stamps in a row, wax in a warmer, and a ledger whose every entry ends the same way.

Examinable.Description: The intake window of Marrowstye is a person at a table, and the person is this one. Stamps in a row, wax in a warmer, and a ledger whose every entry ends the same way.

blueprints.description: A column of pale growth, waist-thick and faintly warm, veined violet under the skin. The light in the veins moves slowly, always in the same direction. It holds up nothing. It is not for holding up.

Examinable.Description: A column of pale growth, waist-thick and faintly warm, veined violet under the skin. The light in the veins moves slowly, always in the same direction. It holds up nothing. It is not for holding up.

blueprints.description: Clean water rising cold through white filaments, clearer than any well in the towns. The sign says it is for you. Nothing here has ever said otherwise.

Examinable.Description: Clean water rising cold through white filaments, clearer than any well in the towns. The sign says it is for you. Nothing here has ever said otherwise.

blueprints.description: Growth in shelves and closed fists, violet over ochre. It was not this size last season. It will not be this size next season.

Examinable.Description: Growth in shelves and closed fists, violet over ochre. It was not this size last season. It will not be this size next season.

blueprints.description: Undercut rock at the rim, wet with spray from below. The green here grows thicker than the green anywhere else in the chunk, and leans in.

Examinable.Description: Undercut rock at the rim, wet with spray from below. The green here grows thicker than the green anywhere else in the chunk, and leans in.

blueprints.description: Not stone. The wall here was grown, in the way a bone is grown, and it is faintly warm where you rest a hand on it. Threads run through the violet in it, all of them going the same way.

Examinable.Description: Not stone. The wall here was grown, in the way a bone is grown, and it is faintly warm where you rest a hand on it. Threads run through the violet in it, all of them going the same way.

blueprints.description: Where every thread in the vault gathers and does not stop. The light off it is steady, and slow, and has the rhythm of something breathing very deeply somewhere a long way off.

Examinable.Description: Where every thread in the vault gathers and does not stop. The light off it is steady, and slow, and has the rhythm of something breathing very deeply somewhere a long way off.

blueprints.description: A person, held. The substrate has taken everything below the shoulders and most of what was above them, and the face it has left is composed, and turned slightly toward you, and has been for a very long time.

Examinable.Description: A person, held. The substrate has taken everything below the shoulders and most of what was above them, and the face it has left is composed, and turned slightly toward you, and has been for a very long time.

blueprints.description: Mature fungus in a low mound, breathing light the colour of new leaves. It is warm the way a body is warm. Everything in this room is arranged around it, and everyone in this room is watching you look at it.

Examinable.Description: Mature fungus in a low mound, breathing light the colour of new leaves. It is warm the way a body is warm. Everything in this room is arranged around it, and everyone in this room is watching you look at it.

blueprints.description: A cell carved into the wall face, bedding folded at the back, a lamp-hook above. Someone sleeps here now and will be laid here later. It is not morbid. It is home.

Examinable.Description: A cell carved into the wall face, bedding folded at the back, a lamp-hook above. Someone sleeps here now and will be laid here later. It is not morbid. It is home.

blueprints.description: Cut names, row on row, oldest at the floor. The village's history is not written down anywhere else; it is this wall.

Examinable.Description: Cut names, row on row, oldest at the floor. The village's history is not written down anywhere else; it is this wall.

blueprints.description: Tended sundew, planted in a ring and kept that way. It catches what walks in and it is not sentimental about it.

Examinable.Description: Tended sundew, planted in a ring and kept that way. It catches what walks in and it is not sentimental about it.

blueprints.description: A stoppered jar of lantern-beetles, hung at head height. They brighten when the room moves. Crush one and every Warden in the village will know inside a breath.

Examinable.Description: A stoppered jar of lantern-beetles, hung at head height. They brighten when the room moves. Crush one and every Warden in the village will know inside a breath.

blueprints.description: A tended field of small sundews across the entry, kept trimmed to ankle height. Stepping across is how the village is introduced to you.

Examinable.Description: A tended field of small sundews across the entry, kept trimmed to ankle height. Stepping across is how the village is introduced to you.

blueprints.description: RIANE. Patch-Tender. Widowed the year the green light came back. Tended forty years. Says the patch sang once, and no one believes her, and she does not care.

Examinable.Description: RIANE. Patch-Tender. Widowed the year the green light came back. Tended forty years. Says the patch sang once, and no one believes her, and she does not care.

blueprints.description: OSSU. Beetle-Master. Went upstairs young and came back old and never said. Good hands. The wall keeps him anyway.

Examinable.Description: OSSU. Beetle-Master. Went upstairs young and came back old and never said. Good hands. The wall keeps him anyway.

blueprints.description: MERRIN, called MOTH. Child. One winter. The light dimmed the night she went and the old people say it was courtesy.

Examinable.Description: MERRIN, called MOTH. Child. One winter. The light dimmed the night she went and the old people say it was courtesy.

blueprints.description: — — — — — The stone here has been chiselled back to smooth. Nothing is cut into it, and the cutting that was there has been taken out to the depth of a thumbnail.

blueprints.description: VASHTI. Tongue. Spoke for the village to three Factors, two Curators, and once, badly, to a god. First Plaque cut at twelve; died at ninety-one; the plaque she cut at twelve is behind this one, and it says, in a child's letters: I WILL SLEEP HERE WHEN I AM DONE. SAVE MY PLACE.

blueprints.description: Broad through the shoulders, pale as the walls, and standing where the light from the patch falls across the entry. She has been watching you since the sundew.

Examinable.Description: Broad through the shoulders, pale as the walls, and standing where the light from the patch falls across the entry. She has been watching you since the sundew.

blueprints.description: Old, and holding a lamp low to the bottom rows. Her hands are chalked white to the wrist from re-cutting letters that were going soft.

blueprints.description: A shelf of rock wide enough to stand on and not much wider. Water finds it, uses it, and goes on down.

blueprints.description: A heavy pit viper the colour of wet stone, coiled where the litter is deepest. It does not rattle and it does not flee. Where these are thick on a slope, something underneath is awake.

Examinable.Description: A heavy pit viper the colour of wet stone, coiled where the litter is deepest. It does not rattle and it does not flee. Where these are thick on a slope, something underneath is awake.

blueprints.description: A long olive colubrid draped along a branch, watching the ground with more attention than it spends on you. Villages that have one nearby say so the way other places mention a good well.

blueprints.description: A tortoise the size of a footstool, going somewhere at its own rate. Some villages have kept one for six generations and treat it as the oldest thing that remembers them.

blueprints.description: Pink-grey sandstone, worn smooth and faintly warm underfoot. Every tepui in the world is the Tree's anatomy turned to stone; this one is the stump itself, and you are standing on it.

blueprints.description: A dome of pink stone, smooth as a knuckle. It was a bough once, or the knot where a bough met the trunk. The scrub grows in its cracks and does not ask.

blueprints.description: A bromeliad the size of a rain barrel, holding a barrel's worth of rain. The water is clear and cold and something small lives its entire life in there. Summit people drink from these and leave the small thing unbothered.

blueprints.description: Falling water lands here and stands a while, cold and bright, before it finds the next shelf down. Things live in it that live nowhere drier.

blueprints.description: An iron pin driven into the rock, and a hand's length of rope still knotted to it. The cut end is old and clean: somebody took the rest with them, or somebody took it from them.

blueprints.description: Growth in shelves and closed fists, brighter than its neighbors, and warm. It is further along than the others. Standing near it feels like being considered.

Examinable.Description: Growth in shelves and closed fists, brighter than its neighbors, and warm. It is further along than the others. Standing near it feels like being considered.

blueprints.description: A board of grown wood, the letters raised in living grain — grown out of it, not carved into it — and weathered smooth by hands. It reads: WALKER. YOU ARE ENTERING US. Walk anywhere. Everything is path. Drink at the seep. It is for you. Eat nothing red. The red is thinking. If you hear singing, it is old singing. It is not for you. You may listen anyway. The singers do not mind. The singers have not minded anything for a long time, and it is a kindness to be heard. Do not dig. If you are tired — truly tired, walker, the kind of tired that has stopped keeping count — lie down anywhere soft. Someone will cover you. If you are only a little tired, keep walking. We can tell the difference. We are patient about the difference. GO GENTLY. EVERYTHING HERE IS SOMEBODY.

blueprints.description: No longer than a hand. The column beside it has grown around one arm, and stopped.

Examinable.Description: No longer than a hand. The column beside it has grown around one arm, and stopped.

blueprints.description: A tidy row of what is being taken back: cloth gone to lace, a boot, chitin, a shape further along than the rest. The rows are straight. Nothing made them straight; they grew that way. Everything here is somebody.

Examinable.Description: A tidy row of what is being taken back: cloth gone to lace, a boot, chitin, a shape further along than the rest. The rows are straight. Nothing made them straight; they grew that way. Everything here is somebody.

Reagent.FlavorText: A fruit of astonishing health, grown from everyone the grove has ever loved. The red is thinking.

blueprints.description: Low growth heavy with red, at the grove edge, where the sign can see it. The sign says eat nothing red. Nothing stops you picking it.

Examinable.Description: Low growth heavy with red, at the grove edge, where the sign can see it. The sign says eat nothing red. Nothing stops you picking it.

blueprints.description: It was somebody's shape once, and the growth kept the shape because the shape still walked. It is not in a hurry. Nothing here is.

Examinable.Description: It was somebody's shape once, and the growth kept the shape because the shape still walked. It is not in a hurry. Nothing here is.

Reagent.FlavorText: A wheezing pouch of spores. Keep it away from flame, and from your face, and honestly from you.

blueprints.description: A moth the size of a hand, dusted the same pale light as the columns. It navigates by the groves, which is to say it is never lost.

Examinable.Description: A moth the size of a hand, dusted the same pale light as the columns. It navigates by the groves, which is to say it is never lost.

blueprints.description: Leaves the color of wine going darker, beaded sticky at every edge. How dark the leaves are is how recently it has eaten. These are quite dark.

Examinable.Description: Leaves the color of wine going darker, beaded sticky at every edge. How dark the leaves are is how recently it has eaten. These are quite dark.

blueprints.description: A spot in the row where the taking-back has further to go. Some of what comes up still has pockets. The grove does not mind; it was never after the pockets.

Examinable.Description: A spot in the row where the taking-back has further to go. Some of what comes up still has pockets. The grove does not mind; it was never after the pockets.

blueprints.description: A small brown frog with a dark W folded across its back. It waits against a mossy trunk, throat lifted. One note, then another. The long space between them seems to belong to the mountain.

blueprints.description: A lichen-coloured lizard flattened against the stone. Its green-brown flanks repeat the mottling of the dome so closely that the yellow eye seems to hang there alone. Tank leaves shiver close by.

blueprints.description: An immense ash-pale eagle, dark beneath the wings. Its talons close slowly on nothing. People who know the slopes watch the ground when this shadow crosses them: what coils below and what circles above have begun keeping the same hours.

blueprints.description: An indigo gecko with an amber throat and a long fine spine above each eye. It holds itself close to the litter, all sharp elbows and patient attention. Several small tracks meet beneath the stone beside it.

blueprints.description: A broad-headed forest frog with a bony casque like a weathered wooden helm. A bead of water clings below its jaw. Underground, such a visitor is worth following: forest frogs do not arrive in sealed rooms.

blueprints.description: Sixteen pale eggs share a hollow under the leaf litter. Blue-black brows watch from the surrounding cracks. A foot in that hollow would have many answers.

blueprints.description: A pale seam holds its line through the pink-grey stone. The mountain remembers a grain older than rock. Even a loose chip seems unwilling to be lifted.

blueprints.description: Sandstone cut from the Root. It weighs more than its size promises, pale grain closed tightly around the memory of wood. Name-holders work it patiently; the stone has never been in a hurry.

blueprints.description: Fresh water runs through a low opening worn smooth in the stone. The current comes from farther away than this pool can explain. Stand here and follow it downward (>) or upward (<).

blueprints.description: A human shape has grown into the stone: shins flat, knees bent, torso arched above the floor. Pale fungus rises from his chest. His open arms reach toward the eastern wall and stop short of it. Nothing has been built in that narrow distance. The pose holds no strain.

blueprints.description: Clouded bands repeat beneath the polished face. The joints are too fine to admit a fingertip.

blueprints.description: Dull iron ribs bind the stone courses. Their rivets are set deep; no filament grows in the seams.

blueprints.description: Iron lies flush within a pale stone frame. A small keyway interrupts the unbroken seam.
